WELCOME, EXPLORER

Your learning garden

Tap a pavilion or its name. Your avatar walks there and opens the results. Tap open ground to walk freely.

Drag to rotate the view. Pinch or use + / − to zoom. On a keyboard, focus the scene then use W A S D or the arrow keys to walk.

The four coloured gateways change the subject. Region portals and the region selector take you to other campuses. Use the arrows to visit the next set of pavilions.

Buildings have equal size and do not encode performance. This is a fictional learning space, not a geographical map. Scores, missing values and caveats come from the existing snapshot.
